title: Under Threat, Saudi Arabia Reroutes Oil Exports Yet Again
summary: Forced away from the Strait of Hormuz in the Persian Gulf, the Saudis turned to the Red Sea. Now they are relying on a less dangerous but more complicated detour via the Suez Canal.
